notes: Piece counts match the parts list per type and colour (444 pieces).

The booklet pictures are small and several sub-assemblies are drawn from odd angles, so the exact rests_on chains inside the base, the Willis Tower and the Hancock arms and modules are best-effort inferences. The per-type counts are exact, but a few single placements are guesses.

Two copies of the Hancock module (steps 100-110) and of the Hancock arm (step 98) are listed in full. Each module's first 3x3 plate is assumed to sit on its own arm's studs.
The whole base is built before the model is rotated at step 30. Step 48 places Big Red on the black 2x2 plate (b87), and step 94 puts the Wrigley tower on the turntable top.
